'''2020 MPC Chris Kelly LS He Is The Chosen One''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Kelly]] at [[2020 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Kelly]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open He Is The Chosen One Kelly LS 2020.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
